description.text:
POC requirements specification for the Stearing component,
Windchill Part 0000003865. Contains material, chemical,
weight, and dimensional requirements for API extraction
and traceability validation.
The Stearing component shall conform to dimensions of 20 x 30 x 40.
The Stearing component shall use Mild Steel.
The Stearing component shall have a maximum weight of 2.50 kg.
The Stearing component shall use an iron-based alloy.
